answer: A backdoor works by implanting malicious software into a system during the supply chain distribution process. This allows an attacker to cause disruption or enable further compromises once the system is deployed to the victim. The backdoor provides unintended access to the system, which can lead to various follow-up attacks [Source 2].

unintended access to systems once they reach the victim and can lead to a variety of follow up attacks.
